purpose: Preserve D08/D12/D13/D15 typed distinctions across C11 incidence, query results, source relations, discovery, structural admission, authority and replay. Missing storage is never allowed to silently encode a semantic state that the governing source/query requires to be explicit.
global_laws: SUBSTANTIVE_RESPONSE != MISSING != DK != REFUSAL != IAP_OR_INAPPLICABLE != NOT_ASKED != INVALID_UNRESOLVED

requirements: Each state is explicit when source semantics distinguish it.
Absence of a substantive event does not determine which absence state applies.
Source-specific special states retain source-native identity and mapping authority.
Coordinate state does not imply generated structural position or actor state.
Risk-set member identity is semantic, not just denominator count.
Equal counts with different member sets remain distinct.
No implicit weight=1.0 repair.
Raw measure remains separately available when weighted measure is unavailable.
Distinct-by-default is the source relation baseline.
A positive state authorizes only the named relation kind and scope.
Semantic equivalence, linkage, pooling, backfill, overlap treatment and retirement do not substitute for one another.
OBSERVED_ZERO means a governed risk set/support exists and the governed outcome measure is zero.
ZERO_SUPPORT means the governed denominator/support is zero or absent under the exact risk-set semantics and cannot be promoted to an observed zero.
VALID_EMPTY is a lawful evaluated empty result, not missing authority or integrity failure.
UNEVALUATED is never a negative empirical result.
COVERAGE_LIMITED does not imply exhaustive absence beyond the evaluated frontier.
A supported discovery result remains a discovery receipt, not structural admission.
Only ADMITTED_FOR_EXACT_STRUCTURAL_USE is positive structural-admission authority.
Admission is exact-use scoped; it is not generic structural truth for other uses.
Applicable denial/noncomparability/limit authority cannot be downgraded to a positive admission.
Later authority versions do not reinterpret historical objects.
DEFER is not DENY and does not manufacture a semantic negative.
Missing/unknown authority fails closed for any operation requiring positive authority.
Replay failure never triggers fuzzy/latest reconstruction.
A serialized-file hash alone cannot prove semantic equivalence unless all proof-relevant fields are covered.

precedence_rules.note: This is a cross-object preflight precedence only. It does not replace owner-specific stage decision order where a frozen downstream contract is more specific.
